brief: A two-storey garage tower sturdy enough that it will never wobble or crack with tins of screws in it.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,1,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full on level 0 with pieces directly above on level 1 (piece:0,0,1, piece:0,1,1, piece:1,0,1) joined by snaps
bin:0,0,1, bin:0,1,1, bin:1,0,1 full-depth bins holding heap-screws-bin, heap-nuts-bin, heap-standoffs-bin props, visible from above (polar 10)
requirements.requirement: Garage storage for tins of screws

requirements.evidence: Triangular 3-cell footprint, double side-connectors on all 3 internal walls per storey, capOpenFaces and lockJoints applied, check_build ok with meshClash clear; but configurator checks fit/collisions only and knows nothing about material, strength, load ratings or cracking — parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material, so no absolute never-wobble/never-crack guarantee can be made
requirements.requirement: Sturdy enough that it will never wobble or crack with tins of screws in it

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell triangular two-storey tower (6 bases) with double side-connectors on every internal wall, capped faces and locked joints, with three full-depth bins on the top level dressed with screws/nuts/standoffs. check_build ok, mesh clear, props visible from above. Strength/crack guarantee is partial: shape bracing helps but load/material safety is outside what the configurator verifies.

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
